ignore.reason: Provided by the framework's bundler; it is never installed.

app.reason: Each app deploys on its own under its base path; shared code goes to packages/*.

design-system.reason: Consumed by the whole ecosystem: it may only depend on itself.

forbidden.reason: Apps are mounted by same-domain iframe, not by import (see the architecture ADR).

exceptions.reason: The site's showcase renders the app's real leaf components, not a mockup.

route.note: What goes in each layer is fixed by the project's pattern catalog.
